title: Ordered interface regulation at Zn electrodes induced by trace gum additives for high-performance aqueous batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04100C, Paper
Kuo Wang, Hongtu Zhan, Wenlong Su, Xiao-Xia Liu, Xiaoqi Sun
A macromolecule additive strategy is presented as a dual deceleration interfacial network to regulate Zn deposition behavior and inhibit side reactions. It enables the stable cycling of Zn electrodes in aqueous batteries.
